abstract: Namecheap hosting is a cheap, good fit for small sites near the US. Independent tests measured 99.29% to 100% uptime, slower speeds in Asia and a renewal price about double the promo.

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

acceptedAnswer.text: It is good for a small site near the US. Cybernews called it a great domain provider and weak web hosting.
Close to the US, yes: TopSiteHosters measured a 232 ms time to first byte. Far from the US it is slower: Cyber Naira measured 1.1 seconds in Asia Pacific without a CDN.

mainEntity.name: How much does Namecheap hosting cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar starts at $2.28 a month. It renews at $55.88 a year, or $5.88 a month on monthly billing.

mainEntity.name: Does Namecheap offer a free trial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It lists 30 days free on shared hosting. The 30-day money-back guarantee does not apply with the free period.
Independent tests measured between 99.29% and 100% uptime. Namecheap advertises 100%.
Namecheap lists 24/7 live chat and tickets. HostingGuider could not confirm phone support.
Yes. Stellar includes 30 mailboxes. Stellar Plus and Business include unlimited mailboxes.

mainEntity.name: Can I host more than three sites on Stellar?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Stellar covers 3 sites. Stellar Plus and Business allow unlimited sites.

mainEntity.name: Does Namecheap include a free domain?

acceptedAnswer.text: HostingGuider reports it does not. Check the plan page at checkout.
Yes for small sites. WordPress installs in one click, and Namecheap lists AI for WordPress. Use a CDN for visitors far from the US.
Yes. It lists AI for WordPress and Sitejet AI Website Builder on every shared plan.
Hostinger measured faster and more consistent in tests, with a lower renewal price. Namecheap keeps domains and hosting in one account.
